notes: Pack and riding animals and vehicles (Plan 4, B1). capacity is the kg of cargo each carries, against 20 kg per member at STR 10; a ridden horse's capacity is what it carries besides its rider. waterPerDay is in days of a member's water (2 kg each), doubled in the desert. upkeepPerDay is fodder, stabling and care in gp while owned. Only riding animals are hired (hirePerDay, per member, for a journey to a settlement). Riding speed is 2× (1.25× in mountains, marsh and jungle, A4). maxPathDanger keeps horses and camels off rough paths to sites; carts and wagons keep to roads. Starting numbers, to be tuned with the I1 economy report.
